title: Equipped to Do His Will
story:
A young boy joined a school football team for the first time.

He was excited, but he quickly realized that being part of a team required more than enthusiasm.

He needed to learn how to work with others, understand his position, and develop his skills.

His coach patiently trained him and gave him the confidence to improve.

Over time, the boy became a better player because he was willing to listen, learn, and practice.

God also prepares us for the work He has called us to do.

He is the God of peace who raised Jesus from the dead, our great Shepherd.

He equips us with everything we need to do His will.

We do not have to depend only on our own abilities.

God can work within us, strengthen us, and shape our hearts so that our lives reflect what pleases Him.

When we surrender ourselves to Him, He faithfully prepares us for whatever He has placed before us.
life_lesson: God does not call you to something without also helping you become equipped for it. Trust Him to work in you and give you what you need to do His will.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being the God of peace and for raising Jesus from the dead.

Thank You for being my Shepherd and for caring for every part of my life.

Equip me with everything I need to do Your will.

Shape my heart, strengthen my faith, and guide my actions so that my life brings You pleasure.

Help me trust that You are working within me even when I feel inadequate.

May Your power work through my life for Your glory.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Is there something God is calling you to do that makes you feel inadequate?

Are you depending on your own ability or trusting God to equip you?

What can you surrender to God today so that He can work through you?
verse: May the God of peace, who brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great Shepherd of the sheep, equip you with everything good for doing His will, and may He work in us what is pleasing to Him, through Jesus Christ.
